annotations.coverageReview: Fresh six-view survey, native front/side frames and four-landmark overlay actually inspected. Garuda has one head. Upper brow/eye, central blue beak, lower beak and side beak cover visible facial anatomy above the scarf. Minimum battle patch 22 vertices. New animations and techniques pending visual inspection.

review.name: Ash Garuda
findings: Fresh source/battle enlarged complete-face and body inspection confirms lower beak stretching in attack/cast, compressed into scarf during recoil. All nine equipped techniques (216 native frames) inspected front/side; appendages and visible support remain coordinated. Candidate facial binding only; sculpt, rig and all curves preserved. Independent frozen facial patches and full geometry plus second visual pass required.

Candidate v1 rejected for lower-collar seam stretch. Candidate v2 broadens the collar transition and passes 203 full-geometry poses and 468 independent facial blends. All 12 candidate raw slices and 216 actual equipped-technique frames inspected. Final second pass: all 24 source/battle raw slices, 32 production transition slices, 24 advancing companion idle frames, 216 equipped-technique frames and 16 atlas cells inspected and pass. Source geometry, rig, UVs, textures and every original animation curve conserved. Local only; whole-roster/main/live release remain pending.
